sourceSentences: Every time a Powder Keg explodes, the cooldown for Trial by Fire resets and Gangplank gains its bonus movement speed.
Trial by Fire cannot be applied with Parrrley nor Powder Keg.
Reapplying Trial by Fire before a previous application has run out will stack the full damage, instead of refreshing the duration.
The keg starts with 3 health and loses 1 every 2;1;0.5 [1;7;13] seconds until it is left with 1 health.
When an enemy destroys it, it is safely defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes and also triggers a chain reaction that explodes other nearby connected kegs.
Each enemy can only be hit once per chain and the damage dealt ignores armor penetration [40% of the target's armor].
The triggering attack on the keg can critically strike, causing the explosion to deal the attack's critical damage.
If the keg was not destroyed, it will consume the effect and the keg will store the damage it would have dealt.
Kegs prematurely grant sight of their explosion radius (including across terrain and into bushes) if Parrrley or a lit fuse is traveling towards them.
Each enemy killed by a Powder Keg explosion that was originally set off by Parrrley also counts for the plunder.
Remove Scurvy can remove the underlying stun from airborne, but a blink or dash ability is required to override the displacement.

And every time he detonates a barrel with his Q, he also gains the bonus gold and silver serpents.
